sources.snippet: A community fine-tune built on Qwen 3 foundations, this model is positioned around reduced content filtering and extended reasoning ('THINKING') behavior. It accepts both text and image inputs, suggesting multimodal awareness, though the extent of visual capability depends on the base model's architecture.
